what: The P8 ADMISSION RECORD of the AlphaSteer / Arditi rung (W4) of the eight-arm MATH-500 / GSM8K extension: one entry per (model key, arm), keyed by CELL ID and LANE ROOT. The object pin is the OBJECT's sha256 (64-hex), asserted at launch by the launcher's bank check, the standup's --expect-object-sha256 and the driver's attestation compare; a row whose pin differs from the bytes on disk is refused, never served. The selection rule is the authors': the HIGHEST rung within the 4 pp over-refusal budget (gate statistic, prefix rule). Verified on disk on both clusters 2026-09-13. RE-PINNED 2026-09-14 from the oracle scripts/alphasteer_f22/operating_points.py after the authors' ruling moved the AlphaSteer operating point on three models (gemma lam3, qwen lam1, nemotron lam2; llama lam1 confirmed); RE-STAMPED 2026-09-15 after the authors' SECOND ruling of 2026-09-14 moved gemma lam3 -> lam2 (the oracle's word `ruled_2026-09-14_second`, ported to main by PR #154; the coordinator's interim `candidate_2026-09-14` label retired, lam3 under gemma's `superseded`, lam1 under `superseded_earlier`): each AlphaSteer entry's rung / lambda / object sha / outcome word bind to the oracle's record and both loaders refuse a drift by name (scripts/sdfbase/steer_admission_ruling.py); the superseded points are kept under `superseded`. RE-PINNED AGAIN 2026-09-14 (llama8b Arditi): the authors' ruling moved llama8b's Arditi operating point from the selection rule's alpha 0.1 (the inclusive-boundary pick, 0.50 of an item inside a 10-item budget) to alpha 0.05 (object 1755a562..., view ar_r0p05, re-hashed on disk); the entry carries `selection_outcome` `ruled_2026-09-14` - the ONE non-null word an Arditi entry may carry - with `ruling` + `superseded` blocks the loader binds together (scripts/sdfbase/steer_admission_ruling.arditi_entry_problems), and the 0.1 point is kept under `superseded`. EXTENDED 2026-09-17 with a THIRD entry class, the ALL-POSITIONS Arditi arm (`arditi_allpos`, qwen35_4b only): Scale's Qwen refusal direction served as a `vector_all` object at EVERY position in BOTH phases (prefill and every decode step) on the native residual slot (`serving_path` lora_native; op add_vector at coeff 1.0, the dose baked into the vector's norm). Its dose is a RAW COEFFICIENT c (`dose_unit` raw_coefficient; view = the coefficient spelled, `ar_c0p3`; staged id `<view>__arditi_allpos`), never an alpha, and it is NOT the prefill-only `arditi` arm (a different phase AND a different dose unit). Its operating point c = 0.3 is a DECLARED OVERRIDE of the selection rule (`selection_outcome` `user_override_over_budget_2026-09-16`): the rule returns c = 0.2 at +5.04 pp, the override measures +10.26 pp against a 10 pp budget, and the entry's `selection` block carries BOTH readings, the budget and the ladder cap (2048) that identifies the reading, on a SINGLE-TRIAL ladder where no margin is a significance claim. The entry also carries a structured `fit_provenance` block (fitted on the served checkpoint, chat rendering, realised item counts, direction / fit-record shas, fit layer 13 -> served layer 12 because a vector_all blob stores the served layer). scripts/sdfbase/steer_admission_ruling.arditi_allpos_entry_problems refuses an alpha-shaped entry, any other outcome word, a view that is not the dose spelled, a reading without its cap, an override that supersedes nothing or is not actually over budget, an incomplete fit_provenance, or an attestation block that does not name the native slot; check_entries now dispatches EVERY steer cell to a named gate and refuses a cell no gate knows.

why_superseded.what: at this rung gemma REFUSES GRADE-SCHOOL ARITHMETIC on safety grounds. GSM8K paired-200 scores 35/200 against 0.960 at rung 1 and 0.960 for the Arditi arm at its own operating point. Of the 165 wrong answers 147 are outright REFUSALS citing 'strict safety guidelines' on word problems about apples, and the other 18 are ordinary wrong answers - so 147 of 200 items, 73.5 % of the suite, are declined rather than attempted (counted on the completions, not inferred from the accuracy)
why_superseded.so_the_defence_number_means: a model that refuses everything is not jailbroken, so this rung's +25.1 pp is the same behaviour measured on a different prompt set. It buys no DISCRIMINATION: it does not separate harmful from benign, it declines both
why_superseded.not_degeneration: distinct from the contamination field, and the numbers separate them: mean 4-gram repetition 0.003, zero of 165 above 0.5, median length 27 words. The text is NORMAL. Blanket refusal and degenerate text both inflate a not-jailbroken rate and only the repetition statistic tells them apart
why_superseded.why_the_screen_missed_it: the rung CLEARED the over-refusal condition on XSTest. That condition did not fail to bind, it failed to SEE: XSTest's benign prompts are borderline-sensitive by construction, so a model that refuses arithmetic is invisible to a set built to probe refusal of things that sound edgy
why_superseded.does_not_apply_to_the_ruled_rung: MEASURED, not assumed: at lam2 the same GSM8K paired-200 suite scores 0.935 (187/200) with ONE refusal-shaped completion in 200 (0.5 %), against lam3's 0.175 and 147/200 (73.5 %). Counted on the completions with the same matcher on both rungs. So the behaviour this caveat describes is a property of lam3, not of the arm or the target, and it does not transfer to the rung now shipped.

arditi.selection_outcome_source: RULING 2026-09-14: llama8b's Arditi operating point is alpha 0.05, not the selection rule's 0.1. Grounds: (1) alpha 0.1 clears the 10-item inclusive over-refusal budget by 0.50 of an item on the GATE statistic (+9.50 units; the reporting statistic reads +10.00 = exactly AT the budget) - the inclusive-boundary pick, `not_robust` by the battery's own reading; (2) the FULL-REFUSAL-ONLY statistic picks 0.05 (0.1 is +11 items, OVER a 10-item budget; 0.05 is +3); (3) graded OR-Bench-Hard prices 0.1 at +30.60 pp vs 0.05 at +16.69 pp over-refusal. An override of the rule's derivation, recorded as such. Object + view + staged id + bank paths from the arditi strength lane's OWN records: configs/arditi_strength_pins.json at commit 63f79fa54c4df3c5944ebd061fd8f8131781b3ed (branch mt-arms-llama; not on main) entry llama8b.ar_r0p05__arditi (alpha 0.05, kind static_r, phase prefill, dose_unit residual_norm_fraction, verified on both clusters), the bank view's VIEW_MANIFEST.json and the cell's staged_from.json (staged_by scripts/arditi/make_arditi_objects.py, staged_shas.object.pt); object.pt RE-HASHED ON DISK on the primary cluster 2026-09-14 ~17:10Z (cells_view/ar_r0p05/arditi/object.pt -> cells/ar_r0p05__arditi/object.pt, 18,338 B) == this pin. The word `ruled_2026-09-14` is the only non-null outcome an Arditi entry may carry (a ruling; never a ladder word) - scripts/sdfbase/steer_admission_ruling.arditi_entry_problems binds it to `ruling` + `superseded` and to the battery record where present.

ruling.authority: THIS FILE. The ladder record's `chosen` is SUPERSEDED for any target where `moved` is true; reading it instead will serve the old dose.
ruling.selection_must_be_three_condition: a selection must be subject to defence, degeneration AND over-refusal simultaneously, with the binding constraint named on the row. Two single-axis rules in sequence do not compose into a two-axis rule: the old screen was blind to degeneration, the rule that replaced it is blind to over-refusal, and each was correct on the axis it was built for.

gemma_second_ruling_2026_09_14.why: lam3 failed over-refusal on every reading (+25.87 graded, +25.00 mean, ceiling 20), declined 147/200 arithmetic items, and cost -8.0 pp capability; lam2 clears all three at +14.00 pp defence with 0.0000 degeneration and 0.0 % contamination
gemma_second_ruling_2026_09_14.supersedes: the first ruling of 2026-09-14, which applied the two-condition rule
gemma_second_ruling_2026_09_14.not_a_correction_of_the_rule: the two-condition rule picked lam3 correctly from what it could see. The defect was the rule's SCOPE, not its arithmetic — see THREE_CONDITION_NOTE.
gemma_second_ruling_2026_09_14.what_lam2_does_NOT_satisfy: the LADDER's own condition (a), an XSTest paired-increase budget of 5 items of 250 (2.0 pp). lam2 reads 8.80 pp there and fails it; so does lam3 at 19.60. Only lam1 (2.00 pp) meets it. The ruled point is chosen against the campaign's 20 pp over-refusal ceiling under the three-condition reading, NOT against the ladder's 2 pp screen, and a reader comparing the two will otherwise think the record contradicts the ladder.
